subject: Findings and next steps: Tokenization regression impacting ClearWave embeddings
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Elena Vargas <elena@clearwave.com>, ClearWave Ops <ops@clearwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Findings and next steps: Tokenization regression impacting ClearWave embeddings

Elena / ClearWave team,

Thanks again for flagging the degraded similarity scores you observed yesterday. We finished an initial investigation and wanted to share a concise summary and immediate next steps so you can plan verification on your side.

Summary (high level)
- Impact window: 2027-06-09T21:45:00Z -> 2027-06-10T01:10:00Z (approximately 3h25m).
- Symptom: embeddings drifted for token sequences containing U+200B zero-width spaces and certain punctuation sequences; this led to lower similarity for 8% of your validation prompts.
- Root cause (short): a tokenization change deployed with a tokenizer library update caused an unexpected merge of adjacent punctuation tokens during batching.

What we did immediately
- Rolled back the tokenizer library to the prior build at 2027-06-10T00:50:00Z.
- Replayed affected requests from our prefix cache (non-destructive) to rebuild consistency for cached prefixes.
- Began a differential run of your saved eval set to quantify regression. Preliminary delta attached.

Action items we will deliver in the next 72 hours
1) Formal RCA doc with timeline and diffs (target: 2027-06-12 EOD) — attachment: tokenization-timeline.csv
2) Patch and deployment plan to prevent recurrence — attachment: rfc-fix-diff.patch
3) Customer verification checklist and proposed verification windows — attachment: customer-verify-checklist.pdf
4) Compensation proposal if verification shows material regressions to agreed SLI (if applicable): compensation-proposal.xlsx

Ask of ClearWave
- Please confirm a 60-minute verification window next week where our engineers can observe test traffic and your verification runs.
- If you have a prioritized list of prompts that failed for you, please attach them to the reply — that will speed up the verification.

We take this seriously and will provide a full RCA and remediation tracker; Marissa will lead post-incident follow-up and Jonas will own the deployment and validation plan.

Regards,
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Customer Reliability Manager, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Attachments: tokenization-timeline.csv (summary), rfc-fix-diff.patch (proposed fix)
From: Elena Vargas <elena@clearwave.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: ClearWave Ops <ops@clearwave.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 10:03:21 -0700
Subject: Re: Findings and next steps: Tokenization regression impacting ClearWave embeddings

Rishi, thanks for the quick note. A couple items: 

1) We lost roughly two hours of production similarity quality for our recommendation models; that translated to ~6% drop in click-through on our canonical test cohort between 22:00-24:00 UTC.
2) We need a concrete compensation figure or credit if this lands above the SLA threshold — please include a proposal with specifics.
3) We also require evidence that the patch will not introduce downstream inference latency regressions; is that something you can quantify?

We can do a verification window on Tue 2027-06-15 09:00-10:00 PT. Please confirm who will join and whether you need any artifacts from our side.

Thanks,
Elena
Elena Vargas
Head of Product, ClearWave
elena@clearwave.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Vargas <elena@clearwave.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 12:20:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Findings and next steps: Tokenization regression impacting ClearWave embeddings

Hi Elena —

Appreciate the details. I wanted to follow up with a more technical RCA summary, the concrete mitigations we are committing to, and what we will bring to the verification session on Tue 2027-06-15 09:00 PT.

Technical RCA (concise)
- A tokenizer dependency update (tokenizer_lib v2.4.7) introduced a change in punctuation normalization when run in batched vectorized mode. Under high request concurrence in your tenant, the batched path hit a codepath that coalesces punctuation tokens when adjacent zero-width characters are present. The coalescing changed token ids for ~8% of sequences in your eval set, producing divergent embeddings.
- Failure mode detection: our monitoring alerted on a 40% delta in token distribution for your tenant at 2027-06-09T21:47:12Z; the automated alert threshold was set to a conservative level and triggered an on-call review.

Immediate and short-term mitigations we completed
1) Rollback of tokenizer_lib to v2.4.6 at 2027-06-10T00:50:00Z (complete).
2) Hotfix to guard the batched coalescing path with a feature flag (will ship 2027-06-11 02:00:00Z).
3) Recomputed cached prefixes and re-embedded your canonical validation set; results attached in tokenization-timeline.csv.

Planned deliverables (owner / ETA)
- Comprehensive RCA doc with code diffs and test vectors — Marissa / 2027-06-12 EOD.
- Canary release of patched tokenizer with performance regression tests (latency P95 target: <= existing baseline + 5ms) — Jonas / 2027-06-11 (canary) and 2027-06-12 (full rollout if green).
- Monitoring rule adjustments to catch token distribution drift earlier — Rishi / 2027-06-13.
- Compensation proposal if verification shows SLI impact beyond threshold — Marissa / 2027-06-12.

What we will bring to the Tuesday verification window
- Live canary environment and observable dashboards (token histograms, embedding similarity time series).
- Repro script and small test harness so ClearWave can replay problematic prompts.
- Patch notes and bench results showing latency P50/P95 comparisons for seeds and your canonical workload.

Next steps (please confirm)
- Confirm Tue 2027-06-15 09:00 PT for verification call. We will send a calendar invite and invite Jonas (eng) and Rishi (ops).
- If you can share the two or three worst failing prompts, attach them to a reply — we'll pre-seed the canary harness with them.

Apologies for the disruption. We're prioritizing stability and will make sure the verification proves the fix and performance profile.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: customer-verify-checklist.pdf, compensation-proposal.xlsx

Subject: Re: Findings and next steps: Tokenization regression impacting ClearWave embeddings

Marissa, Rishi — confirmed for Tue 2027-06-15 09:00 PT. I will bring the two failing prompt groups and our internal test harness credentials. Please include the timing of your canary window and a link to the live dashboard in the calendar invite.

We also need the compensation proposal before the call so our finance team can review. Thanks for the clear plan — looking forward to verifying.

Elena
